Hi all,

Sarah Turner (Data Infra) is moving to final on-site loop next week. Hiring manager wants a compact 2.5hr loop with a +1 debrief immediately after. We have these constraints:
- Candidate availability window: Wed 5/17 10:00-14:30 PT or Thu 5/18 09:00-12:00 PT.
- Role needs: system design (senior), infra reliability, and execution + culture debrief.

Ask: can folks commit slots or nominate backups? Specifically we need:
1) System design interviewer (60m) — prefers senior infra engineer.
2) Reliability deep dive (45m).
3) Execution/behavioral (30m).
4) Debrief lead (15-20m) to close notes and grade.

Attachments: sarah_turner_resume.pdf (profile + take-home summary).

If you can't cover your usual slot, please reply with a short-hand note and a suggested replacement from the pool. I'm trying to produce a compact panel so we can get a same-day debrief.

Thanks,
Priyom

Thanks Priyom — quick read of the resume looks promising. I'm happy to take system design but I have an all-hands 11:30-12:30 on Wed which conflicts with the preferred window. I can do:
- Wed 10:00-11:00 PT (system design) OR Thu 09:00-10:00 PT.

If I take system design, Monica could you take the reliability slot? Monica, if you can do reliability I'll own the exec/behavioral debrief pairing (I can take the 30m). If neither works, I can try to swap with Laura for system design but will need an explicit backup in case the all-hands overruns.

Also: proposing a \"heatmap\" approach for coverage — we map interviewer load (low/med/high) across the week and pick the least-loaded slots so we don't hit the same people repeatedly. I'll attach a quick snapshot after replies.
